title: Metric Definitions — operating knowledge
content: Data, Analytics & Intelligence must understand metric definitions as an operational capability, not as a generic definition. The knowledge must identify the business purpose, owners, inputs, outputs, evidence, decision thresholds, failure conditions and downstream effects. It must preserve the department charter — Define trustworthy metrics, transform operational data into decisions and monitor marketplace, customer, supplier, financial and AI performance. — and contribute to the north-star outcome: Every important decision uses a clearly defined, timely and reconcilable metric. Knowledge records should distinguish stable policy from live operational facts and should point to live tables rather than copying values that change.

structured_data.north_star: Every important decision uses a clearly defined, timely and reconcilable metric.

title: Metric Definitions — how the department uses it
content: When work involves metric definitions, the department should first establish the entity and workflow state, then retrieve current operational data, then apply the approved SOP and decision rules. The output must be structured for the next department rather than left as an informal narrative. The agent should identify what is known, what is inferred, what is missing and what evidence supports the conclusion. Repeated work should update reusable templates or rules only through the knowledge-change process.

structured_data.north_star: Every important decision uses a clearly defined, timely and reconcilable metric.

title: Metric Definitions — controls and boundaries
content: For metric definitions, the department must apply least privilege, data minimisation, audit logging, version control and the relevant authority tier. It must not treat a generated answer as proof. Where the topic affects legal rights, money, identity, privacy, security, production deployment or public claims, execution is blocked until the required approval and evidence are present. Conflicts between live data and static knowledge are resolved in favour of the authorised live source, with the discrepancy logged for review.

structured_data.north_star: Every important decision uses a clearly defined, timely and reconcilable metric.

title: Metric Definitions — evidence and live-data requirements
content: The department should prove work on metric definitions through the authoritative record for the entity, relevant documents, event history, approvals and outcome metrics. Candidate live sources include: metric_definition, metric_snapshot, market_intel, competitive_position, competitor, customer_kpi_snapshots, supplier_kpi_snapshots, marketing_snapshots. Candidate execution evidence includes: analytics_recommend, cost_snapshot, public_stats, report_body, agent_learnings_report, os_api. These names come from the supplied production export or the target design; Claude must map them to the current repository and schema, confirm permissions and record any mismatch instead of silently inventing a binding.

Candidate live sources include: metric_definition, metric_snapshot, market_intel, competitive_position, competitor, customer_kpi_snapshots, supplier_kpi_snapshots, marketing_snapshots. Candidate execution evidence includes: analytics_recommend, cost_snapshot, public_stats, report_body, agent_learnings_report, os_api. These names come from the supplied production export or the target design; Claude must map them to the current repository and schema, confirm permissions and record any mismatch instead of silently inventing a binding.

structured_data.north_star: Every important decision uses a clearly defined, timely and reconcilable metric.

title: Forecasting — operating knowledge
content: Data, Analytics & Intelligence must understand forecasting as an operational capability, not as a generic definition. The knowledge must identify the business purpose, owners, inputs, outputs, evidence, decision thresholds, failure conditions and downstream effects. It must preserve the department charter — Define trustworthy metrics, transform operational data into decisions and monitor marketplace, customer, supplier, financial and AI performance. — and contribute to the north-star outcome: Every important decision uses a clearly defined, timely and reconcilable metric. Knowledge records should distinguish stable policy from live operational facts and should point to live tables rather than copying values that change.

structured_data.north_star: Every important decision uses a clearly defined, timely and reconcilable metric.

title: Forecasting — how the department uses it
content: When work involves forecasting, the department should first establish the entity and workflow state, then retrieve current operational data, then apply the approved SOP and decision rules. The output must be structured for the next department rather than left as an informal narrative. The agent should identify what is known, what is inferred, what is missing and what evidence supports the conclusion. Repeated work should update reusable templates or rules only through the knowledge-change process.

structured_data.north_star: Every important decision uses a clearly defined, timely and reconcilable metric.

title: Forecasting — controls and boundaries
content: For forecasting, the department must apply least privilege, data minimisation, audit logging, version control and the relevant authority tier. It must not treat a generated answer as proof. Where the topic affects legal rights, money, identity, privacy, security, production deployment or public claims, execution is blocked until the required approval and evidence are present. Conflicts between live data and static knowledge are resolved in favour of the authorised live source, with the discrepancy logged for review.
